mentions.name: Forking the Internet
mentions.description: An effort to repurpose internet technology for community benefit rather than greed, corporate interests, or predation.
mentions.problem: Internet technology is currently used for greed, corporations, and predation instead of serving communities.
mentions.source_excerpt: forking the internet. taking internet technology and using if for community rather than (pick 1: greed, corporations, predation).
mentions.author: talkingtab
